full_name: Ciprian S. Borcea | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Mathematics Elizabeth S. and Richard M. Cashin Fellow Rider University
bio: Ciprian S. Borcea is a professor of mathematics at Rider University, in Lawrenceville, New Jersey. He is an algebraic-geometer interested in applications of geometric models to protein ﬂexibility, kinematics of linkages or periodic frameworks, and meta-material design.
